Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Class BulkFieldChange

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.BulkFieldChange
public final class BulkFieldChange extends Object
An immutable, structural change to one root-level resource field.

The field is an exact literal key. It is never interpreted as a JSON Pointer, JSONPath, or nested-property expression. BulkFieldChanges checks structural allowlists; authorization and domain validation remain mandatory in the execution layer.
